name: ⭐ a multi-line if keeps only its first line (r1 survivor)
expect: ⭐ a multi-line if: the header AND every test line are decision lines (r1)

name: ⭐ a multi-line return/raise/assert keeps only its first line (r1)
expect: ⭐ a multi-line return, except header and raise are decision lines on EVERY line (r1)

name: ⭐ except clauses are no longer decisions (r1 survivor)
expect: ⭐ a multi-line return, except header and raise are decision lines on EVERY line (r1)

name: conditional-expression tests are not decisions
expect: ...including a conditional expression in a PLAIN assignment, where nothing else makes it a decision

name: exit calls are not decisions
expect: an exit call is a decision line

name: self_test bodies are code under test
edits: if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and "self_test" in node.name:
expect: a self_test function's lines are cases, not code under test

name: ⭐ an edit covers its whole find span again (r1: context lines covered)
expect: ⭐ an edit COVERS only the lines its find and replace differ on (r1: context lines covered too)

name: an empty find text is not skipped
expect: an empty find text covers nothing (not every line)

name: ⭐ a path keeps git's trailing TAB (r1)
expect: ⭐ a path with a SPACE is read without git's trailing TAB (r1)

name: removed lines are not recorded
expect: added lines are read on the NEW side, removed on the OLD side, per hunk — a pure insertion removes none

name: ⭐ deleted decision lines are not warned (r1)
edits: found += [(p, n, text, "deleted") for n, text in deleted(removed, o.stdout)]
expect: ...and the same line DELETED is warned too, read from the merge-base

name: ⭐ the diff is two-dot, not three-dot (r1 survivor)
expect: ...and the diff is the THREE-dot range against the base

name: ⭐ the per-file cap is never applied (r1 survivor)
expect: at most CAP warnings are shown per file, and the rest are COUNTED

name: no annotation in Actions
expect: ...and in GitHub Actions it is ALSO an annotation on the diff (r1: plain text nobody read)

name: ⭐ git missing is a traceback again (r1)
edits: except OSError as exc:  # git itself missing
except ValueError as exc:  # git itself missing
expect: ⭐ git itself missing is CANNOT RUN, not a traceback (r1)

name: ⭐ an unknown base reports a clean zero instead of CANNOT RUN
expect: ⭐ an unknown base is CANNOT RUN (exit 2), never 'nothing changed'

name: ⭐ a raising loader reports a clean pass (r1 survivor)
edits: return 2, [f"CANNOT RUN — loading the mutation manifests failed: {exc}. Treat as NOT CHECKED."]
return 0, [f"CANNOT RUN — loading the mutation manifests failed: {exc}. Treat as NOT CHECKED."]
expect: a loader that RAISES is CANNOT RUN, never a clean pass (r1: this arm was unwitnessed)

name: refused manifests report a clean pass
edits: return 2, ["CANNOT RUN — the mutation manifests do not load:"]
return 0, ["CANNOT RUN — the mutation manifests do not load:"]
expect: manifests the loader refuses (here: none at all) are CANNOT RUN, never a clean pass

name: ⭐ a non-UTF-8 script is a traceback again (r1)
expect: ⭐ a manifested script that is not UTF-8 is NOT CHECKED, not a traceback (r1)

name: an unreadable base side is silent
edits: not_checked.append(f"NOT CHECKED {p}: cannot read the base side, so deleted lines are unknown")
expect: a base side that cannot be read is NOT CHECKED, not a silent zero
